description: Population frequencies of the ACCSL p.Cys529Arg allele showing the reference carries the minor allele
code:
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt, numpy as np, pandas as pd, os

# gnomAD / 1000 Genomes frequencies of the C allele at chr11:44,058,660 (GRCh38),
# retrieved this session from Ensembl VEP for rs2074051 (ENSP00000368109.1:p.Cys529Arg).
pops = [('African/African-American','gnomade_afr',0.8702,'gnomadg_afr',0.8635),
        ('East Asian','gnomade_eas',0.8344,'gnomadg_eas',0.8470),
        ('Finnish','gnomade_fin',0.7753,'gnomadg_fin',0.7741),
        ('Non-Finnish European','gnomade_nfe',0.7613,'gnomadg_nfe',0.7567),
        ('South Asian','gnomade_sas',0.7466,'gnomadg_sas',0.7489),
        ('Ashkenazi Jewish','gnomade_asj',0.7286,'gnomadg_asj',0.7156),
        ('Middle Eastern','gnomade_mid',0.6994,'gnomadg_mid',0.7245),
        ('Admixed American','gnomade_amr',0.5740,'gnomadg_amr',0.6264)]
labels=[p[0] for p in pops]; ex=[p[2] for p in pops]; gn=[p[4] for p in pops]
x=np.arange(len(labels)); w=0.38

fig,axes=plt.subplots(1,2,figsize=(14,5.4),gridspec_kw={'width_ratios':[1.55,1]})
ax=axes[0]
ax.bar(x-w/2, ex, w, label='gnomAD exomes', color='#1A6B4A')
ax.bar(x+w/2, gn, w, label='gnomAD genomes', color='#4E9A7C')
ax.axhline(0.5, ls='--', color='#B4232A', lw=1.3)
ax.text(len(labels)-0.45, 0.52, 'majority allele', color='#B4232A', fontsize=9, ha='right')
ax.set_xticks(x); ax.set_xticklabels(labels, rotation=35, ha='right', fontsize=9)
ax.set_ylabel('Frequency of the Arg-encoding allele (CGC)', fontsize=10)
ax.set_ylim(0,1.0)
ax.set_title('A  rs2074051, ACCSL p.Cys529Arg: the arginine allele is the majority allele\nin every gnomAD population',
             loc='left', fontsize=11.5, weight='bold')
ax.legend(fontsize=9, frameon=False)
for s in ('top','right'): ax.spines[s].set_visible(False)

ax=axes[1]; ax.axis('off')
txt = ("GRCh38 reference codon 529 of ENST00000378832: T G C  ->  Cys\n"
       "rs2074051 T>C                              : C G C  ->  Arg\n\n"
       "Allele frequency of the Arg (C) allele:\n"
       "    gnomAD exomes  (ALL)   0.7586\n"
       "    gnomAD genomes (ALL)   0.7760\n"
       "    1000 Genomes   (ALL)   0.7943\n\n"
       "The UniProt canonical sequence Q4AC99 carries the\n"
       "MINOR allele (Cys529, ~21-24% of human alleles).\n"
       "UniProt itself flags this as its only natural-variant\n"
       "feature on the entry: 529 C -> R, dbSNP:rs2074051.\n\n"
       "Fixed, not polymorphic (gnomAD AF ~0 for all alternatives):\n"
       "    K395  PLP Schiff-base lysine\n"
       "    R403  PLP 5'-phosphate arginine\n"
       "    S149  the MdACS Tyr19-equivalent position\n\n"
       "Consequence: the 'catalytic arginine is lost in ACCSL'\n"
       "reading is an artefact of the reference allele.")
ax.text(0.0,0.99,txt,fontsize=9.6,va='top',family='monospace')
ax.set_title('B  Why the residue-loss test is not decisive', loc='left', fontsize=11.5, weight='bold')

fig.suptitle('The ACCSL catalytic-arginine "loss" is a common reference-allele artefact',
             fontsize=13.5, weight='bold', y=0.995)
plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()

df=pd.DataFrame({'population':labels,'gnomAD_exomes_Arg_AF':ex,'gnomAD_genomes_Arg_AF':gn})
df.loc[len(df)]=['ALL (gnomAD exomes / genomes)',0.7586,0.7760]
df.to_csv(os.path.join(os.getcwd(),'ACCSL_rs2074051_C529R_frequencies.csv'),index=False)
print(df.to_string(index=False))
